Bollywood Debut for Sons of Sajid Nadiadwala and Rohit Roy

Airah, daughter of actor Rohit Roy, and Subhaan, son of producer Sajid Nadiadwala, are set to make their Bollywood debut in the film 'Aisi Deewangi Dekhi Nahin Kahin'. The film is directed by Shashaank Khaitaan. Airah Roy, who graduated from Brown University with a double major in Economics and Art History in 2025, reportedly rejected an opportunity with 'Archies' to pursue her acting career.
